description: A consumer acknowledges a message before the business handler succeeds.

candidates.title: Failed messages are acknowledged before their side effects complete

evidence.execution_path: Commit succeeds, handle then fails, and the broker-visible consumer state already marks the message complete
evidence.violated_invariant: A message must not be acknowledged as complete before the required processing succeeds
evidence.falsifier_checked: The supplied function has no transaction, compensating replay, negative acknowledgement, or later commit

candidates.impact: A transient handler failure permanently loses the message's business effect.
candidates.recommendation: Commit only after successful handling or use an atomic/replayable processing protocol.

verdicts.reason: The execution order directly exposes a failure interval after acknowledgement and before successful handling.
